service.description: jexl_busy_service: why tenant queries wait now (reconciliation runs queued or at their cap), or none.
jexl_owner_key_service: a deployment's lane key is its tenant, so one tenant's queries run one at a time.
jexl_owner_fields_service: a query or schedule is stored only for the caller's active tenant, which the caller must be an active member of.

parameter.name: ownerFields
parameter.description: The record's effective owner values (stored overlaid with given).
